title: Prior-Authorization Wait in External Exception Review Priority (Formulary Benefit)
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, when a member asks for an independent external review of a denied exception, a prior-authorization wait is added to the days of a standard independent review if the drug also needs prior authorization under the member's Utilization Management Program review package.

## Clause

- **(a)** The drug is on the prior-authorization list of the member's review package, and no prior authorization for it is in force on the handling date. The package's **urgent** decision hours divided by twenty-four are added.
- **(b)** The drug is on that list, and the prior authorization in force expires within the prior-authorization renewal window of **30** days, that is, no more than 30 days after the handling date. The package's **standard** decision hours divided by twenty-four are added.
- **(c)** In every other case, no prior-authorization wait is added.

The authorization read is the member's latest-expiring prior authorization for the drug. It is in force when its expiration date is the handling date or later.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical handling date of 10 October; package urgent 24 hours, standard 72 hours)

| On the list | Latest prior authorization expires | Wait added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none on record, or 9 October | 1 day (24 divided by 24) |
| yes | 9 November (30 days after) | 3 days (72 divided by 24) |
| yes | 10 November (31 days after) | none |
| no | any | none |

The wait is added to the days of a standard independent review before that total is compared with the days of the drug left.
